title: LaTeX source and verification code for the paper The Conjectures of Ashoke Sen
description:
The complete LaTeX source of the paper The Conjectures of Ashoke Sen, with its figures and the compiled PDF, together with the exact-arithmetic computation of the quarter-BPS dyon indices in code/siegel_dyons.py and the Lean 4 file lean/SenConjectures.lean.

The paper examines thirty-six statements made by Ashoke Sen as conjectures, or as results extended beyond the case in which they were derived, and gives each a verdict: proved, confirmed without proof, incomplete, or false as stated. Two are false: the positivity of the single-centred dyon index fails in the Z_2 toroidal orbifold of type II string theory, where the paper computes twenty-one negative indices exactly from the product formula for the Siegel form, and tachyon matter is not the final state of an inhomogeneous brane decay, where a convexity criterion gives a caustic in finite time. For every unproved claim the paper names the missing step.

code/siegel_dyons.py expands the product formula for 1/Phi_10 and for the Siegel form of the orbifold in exact integer arithmetic, verifies the wall-crossing formula on both sides of a wall, and lists the negative single-centred indices. lean/SenConjectures.lean repeats the expansion inside the Lean 4 kernel, from the definitions of the theta functions, the eta function and the Eisenstein series, and proves the finite statements of the paper by decide; it compiles against a bare Lean 4 toolchain and every theorem depends on no axiom or on propositional extensionality alone. figures/make_figures.py draws the three figures.
